items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: Rod Klass used to bum around with Tesch, and Bud Jacobson was in town, wasn't he?

ctx.x: Do you remember any others of their general category? The early first generation horn men?
Well, Rod Klass used to bum around with Tesch, and Bud Jacobson was in town, wasn't he? Bud is, to me, representative of Chicago style, beautifully.
And yet he, I think, would be one of the first to say that, well, he was trying to play the rules that Teschmacher laid down. He'd constantly refer to Teschmacher's solo as the right way to play it.
